verse.verse_1: A kan mẽ suke tambayar jũna?
verse.verse_2: A kan muhimmin lãbãri mai girma (Alƙur'ãni)?
verse.verse_3: Wanda suke sãɓa wa jũna a cikinsa?
verse.verse_6: Ashe, ba Mu sanya ƙasa shimfiɗa ba?
verse.verse_8: Kuma, Mun halitta ku mazã da mãtã?
verse.verse_10: Kuma, Muka sanya dare (ya zama) sutura?
verse.verse_11: Kuma, Muka sanya yini (yazama) lõkacin nẽman abinci?
verse.verse_12: Kuma, Muka gina, a samanku, sammai bakwai mãsu ƙarfi?
verse.verse_13: Kuma, Muka sanya fitila mai tsanin haske (rãnã)?
verse.verse_14: Kuma, Muka saukar daga cikakkun girãgizai, ruwa mai yawan zuba?
verse.verse_15: Dõmin, Mu fitar da ƙwaya da tsiri game da shi?
verse.verse_17: Lalle ne, rãnar rarrabẽwa tã kasance abin ƙayyadẽ wa lõkaci.
verse.verse_18: Rãnar da zã a yi bũsa a cikin ƙaho, sai ku zo, jama'a jama'a.
verse.verse_19: Kuma, aka buɗe sama, sai ta kasance ƙõfõfi.
verse.verse_20: Kuma, aka tafiyar da duwãtsu, sai suka kasance ƙũra.
verse.verse_21: Lalle ne, Jahannama tã kasance madãkata.
verse.verse_22: Ga mãsu ƙẽtare iyãkõki, tã zama makõma.
verse.verse_23: Sunã, mãsu zama a cikinta, zãmunna.
verse.verse_24: Bã su ɗanɗanãwar wani sanyi a cikinta, kuma bã su ɗanɗana abin sha.
verse.verse_25: Fãce tafasasshen ruwa da ruɓaɓɓen jini.
verse.verse_27: Lalle ne, sũ, sun kasance bã su fãtar sauƙin wani hisãbi.
verse.verse_28: Kuma, suka ƙaryata game da ãyõyinMu, ƙaryatãwa!
verse.verse_29: Alhãli, kõwane abu Mun ƙididdigẽ shi, a rubũce.
verse.verse_30: Sabõda haka, ku ɗanɗana domin haka, bã zã Mu ƙara muku kõme ba fãce azãba.
verse.verse_31: Lalle ne, mãsu taƙawã nã da wani wurin sãmun babban rabo.
verse.verse_35: Bã su jin yãsassar magana, a cikinta, kuma bã su jin ƙaryatãwa.
verse.verse_36: Dõmin sakamako daga Ubangijinka, kyautã mai yawa.
verse.verse_37: Ubangijin sammai da ƙasa da abin da yake a tsakãninsu, Mai rahama, bã su da ikon yin wata magana daga gare Shi.
verse.verse_38: Rãnar da Rũhi da malã'iku zã su tsaya a cikin safu, bã su magana, sai wanda Allah Ya yi masa izni, kuma ya faɗi abin da ke daidai.
verse.verse_39: Wancan, shi ne yini na gaskiya; to wanda ya so, ya riƙa makõma zuwa ga Ubangijinsa.
verse.verse_40: Lalle ne, Mũ, Mun yi muku gargaɗin azãba makusanciya, rãnar da mutum ke dũbi zuwa ga abin da hannãyensa suka aikata, kuma kafiri ya ce: "Kaitona, dã dai nã zama turɓãya!"
